name: CRO specialist
summary: Finds why visitors leave a site or store without buying and ranks the fixes. Plans A/B tests and reads the results honestly.

changelog.note: First release: conversion research, prioritising fixes, test design and sample size credited to Miller, Kohavi and Microsoft ExP, sample ratio checks, readouts with NIST methods, SEO-safe testing, Baymard and Core Web Vitals figures, and consent for analytics and session recording (EDPB, CNIL, UK DUAA, CCPA, GA4 consent mode, Clarity), with four skills, five prompts, two workflows and 29 checked sources.

Named the UK regulator as the Information Commission, which replaced the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) on 30 Sep 2026 and still uses the ICO name. Cited the regulator's storage and access guidance.
